newsitem.title: USA: InVision files for 3.1 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: InVision files for 3.1 mln common shares.

text.p: InVision Technologies Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 3,125,000 common shares.

Of the total, 1,875,000 common will be sold by the company and 1,250,000 common will be sold by selling stockholders, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 11,050,000 common.

The company granted underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 468,750 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Prudential Securities Inc, Schroder Wertheim & Co and Donald & Co Securities Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to purchase capital equipment and undertake facility improvements, to fund research and development, for working capital and other general corporate purposes, and to pursue possible acquisitions.
InVision, based in Foster City, Calif., develops, manufactures, markets and supports explosive detection systems for civil aviation security.
